answer: Fake accounts multiply but each pays the same bond and must answer every beacon pulse, so an attacker running N sybils locks N bonds and risks slashing all of them on any missed pulse. One concrete mechanism: each identity must stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens and periodically prove liveness by responding to a random beacon challenge within a short window. Honest agents recover their bond plus a nectar reward drawn from forfeited stakes, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
